case_name: Union Of India vs Pankaj Kumar Sharma
facts_of_case: The respondent's father died in harness. The respondent applied for compassionate appointment. The petitioner rejected the application on the ground that the deceased railway servant married the applicant's mother without permission.

legal_principles.principle: Children of a void marriage are legitimate.
legal_principles.held: Under Section 16 of this Act children of a void marriage are legitimate.

legal_principles.principle: No distinction can be made amongst the children of the first and second wife of a deceased employee.
legal_principles.held: In view of the law as settled by the Supreme Court, no distinction can be made amongst the children of the first and second wife of a deceased employee.

legal_principles.principle: The children of the second wife cannot be treated as illegitimate.
legal_principles.held: Children of a void marriage are legitimate. In view of the decision of the Apex Court in the case of Rameshwari Devi (supra), the children of the second wife cannot be treated as illegitimate.

legal_principles.principle: The eldest son of the second wife is entitled to claim appointment on compassionate ground.
legal_principles.held: Therefore, the eldest son of the second wife, namely the petitioner No.2 herein is entitled to claim appointment of compassionate ground on account of the sudden death of the employee concerned.

legal_principles.principle: A circular preventing the children of the second wife from being considered for appointments on compassionate ground cannot be sustained in the eye of law.
legal_principles.held: We are, however, of the opinion that the circular issued by the Railway Board on 2nd January, 1992 preventing the children of the second wife from being considered for appointments on compassionate ground cannot be sustained in the eye of law in view of the specific provision of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 and pursuant to the decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Rameshwari Devi (supra).

outcome.final_order: The Tribunal quashed the petitioner's communication rejecting the respondents application and directed the petitioner to consider the respondent's case for grant of compassionate appointment under the scheme.
